results.title: Pentagon Review Confirms 153 Civilian Deaths From US Campaign Against Yemen Houthis
results.description: A Pentagon review found that US military strikes targeting Iran-backed Houthi rebels in Yemen in 2025 killed 153 civilians and injured 243 others.
